{{Quote|Oh, if I'd known how much trouble it was being dictator, I'd have stayed on the farm.|Craw|<ref name="Droids (1995) 6">[[Droids (1995) 6|''Droids'' (1995) 6]]</ref>}}
'''Craw''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Targonnian]] who served as the self-styled [[Dictator-Forever]] of [[Targonn/Legends|Targonn]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was extremely self-absorbed and cared little for the troubles of his people, creating a 99 percent tax rate, and forcing child labor. The chief enforcer of his will was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Steggus]]. Craw sought the secret of [[Savorium herb|savorium]] which he planned to utilize to stop the peasants under his rule from complaining about the poor conditions in which they lived. However, he was thwarted by the forces of [[Zorneth]].

==Behind the scenes==
Dictator-Forever Craw appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Droids: Season of Revolt|Season of Revolt]]'' story arc of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[1995]] ''[[Star Wars: Droids (1995)|Star Wars: Droids]]'' series, written by [[Jan Strnad]]. In the three issues where he appeared, Craw was penciled by [[Bill Hughes]], inked by [[Keith Williams]] and [[Rich Perrotta]], and colored by [[Perry McNamee]].
